name: tintloom
description: Image generation and editing for Claude with your own provider keys: OpenAI gpt-image, Google Gemini Nano Banana, fal.ai (Seedream, Flux), BytePlus ModelArk (Seedream) or a hosted endpoint. Images appear in an inline card.

openai_api_key.title: OpenAI API key
openai_api_key.description: For gpt-image models. Leave empty if you don't use OpenAI. Create one at platform.openai.com/api-keys.

gemini_api_key.title: Google Gemini API key
gemini_api_key.description: For Nano Banana models. Leave empty if you don't use Gemini. Create one at aistudio.google.com/apikey.

fal_api_key.title: fal.ai API key
fal_api_key.description: For Seedream, Flux and other fal models. Leave empty if you don't use fal. Create one at fal.ai/dashboard/keys.

modelark_api_key.title: BytePlus ModelArk API key
modelark_api_key.description: For ByteDance's own Seedream models. Leave empty if you don't use ModelArk. Create one in the BytePlus ModelArk console (API key management).

default_provider.title: Default provider
default_provider.description: Which provider makes images when you don't name one. auto uses the first one that has a key.
